title: Personal Loans Refinance-Purpose Quotes: Funding Cushion for Repeated Quotes
content:
## Rule

Repeated refinance quotes on a Personal Loans loan carry a funding cushion of extra interest days, counting the refinance-purpose quotes already issued on the loan fewer than one whole calendar month (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the quote date (quotes for any other purpose are not counted): two or more such quotes add 3 interest days; exactly one adds 1 interest day; none adds no day. Cushion days carry the current interest rate.

| Refinance-purpose quotes already issued in the window | Extra interest days |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 3 |
| exactly 1 | 1 |
| none | none |

## Counting the window (hypothetical dates, new quote on 15 June)

| Earlier quote | Purpose | Whole months before 15 June | Counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 16 May | refinance | 0 (day 15 is smaller than day 16) | yes |
| 15 May | refinance | 1 | no |
| 2 June | borrower payoff | 0 | no: other purpose |
| 2 June and 10 June | refinance | 0 each | yes, two quotes: 3 extra days |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

On a quote whose interest days are otherwise 18, one refinance-purpose quote issued 9 days earlier adds 1 day: the quoted interest runs over 19 days, the added day at the current interest rate.
